summary: Verified footer responsive fix on mobile (390x844) and desktop (1920x800). All 8 acceptance criteria pass: mobile stacks copyright above logos (flex-col), logos smaller (Regio+ h-5=20px, Koodh h-4=16px), no horizontal overflow, both logos fully within viewport (Koodh right=226, Regio+ right=130, innerWidth=390). Desktop keeps side-by-side layout with h-7/h-6 (28px/24px). Regio+ is a plain (parent DIV, not A), Koodh img is wrapped in .

issues: Fixed 'Nu speelt' player bar visually overlaps footer bottom row and clips Koodh logo visually (still shows '<oodh'). DOM-wise the logo is not clipped (koodhRight=1560 << innerWidth=1920), but the fixed player element covers it. Unrelated to this iteration's fix scope but worth informing main agent — consider adding bottom padding to page/footer equal to player height, or hide player when footer bottom bar is in view.

action_items: OPTIONAL: On desktop, the persistent 'Nu speelt' bottom player overlays the footer's bottom bar and visually clips the Koodh logo. Add bottom padding to reserve space for the player, or reduce z-index/hide player when footer is fully visible.
critical_code_review_comments: Footer.jsx bottom row implementation is clean: 'flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-4' with flex-shrink-0 on both logo elements — matches spec exactly.
koodhRight in DOM is fine on all viewports; visual clipping on desktop is caused by fixed player overlay, not layout.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Footer responsive fix verified. All 8 spec bullets pass. Only remaining concern is separate/pre-existing: fixed audio player on desktop overlaps the footer's copyright/logos row.
rca of the issue: Original bug: on mobile the footer bottom row had all three items (copyright + Regio+ + Koodh) forced onto a single flex row without wrapping, causing horizontal overflow and clipping Koodh. Fix (verified): parent now uses 'flex flex-col md:flex-row', so mobile stacks copyright above logos; logos are also reduced (h-5/h-4 on mobile, h-7/h-6 on desktop) with flex-shrink-0 to prevent squashing.
